source.title: Amphibian (chorus frog, wood frog, tiger salamander) surveys in Rocky Mountain National Park (1986-2022)
source.reason_epoch: post-2002 data were collected under an occupancy framework with waterbodies visited at least twice during the active season

ecological_question: conditional on adult-stage occupancy, when and where does reproductive-stage evidence fail to occur, and does environmental stress change that adult-to-reproductive-state coupling?

stage_state_concept.upstream: adult-stage or aural adult evidence, using only explicit source coding
stage_state_concept.downstream: egg and/or larval pre-metamorphic evidence, using only explicit source coding
forbidden_inference: generic species presence is not automatically adult-stage evidence
missing stage record is not absence
juvenile/metamorph evidence is not adult recruitment unless source design identifies that transition

existing_2025_prior_art.citation: Kissel AM, Watry MK, Bredeweg E, Muths E. 2025. Ecosphere 16:e70210. DOI 10.1002/ecs2.70210
existing_2025_prior_art.cannot_claim: novel analysis of overall RMNP amphibian occupancy or persistence
existing_2025_prior_art.target_difference: stage-conditional reproductive-state occupancy within occupied wetlands

allowed_structural_opening: ScienceBase file names, sizes, hashes and media types
distinct nonnumeric categorical labels for species, life stage, observation/detection method and survey status
counts of rows/site-years/visits by taxon and categorical life-stage label
forbidden_before_model_freeze: selecting a taxon or life stage because it produces a stronger result
reusing the 2025 paper's fitted occupancy outcomes as our response
